snippet.title: [GAME PV]Mizuki Demon Slaying Housewife
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941770/

Languages: English , Japanese , Simplified Chinese .

STORY
In a world where demons and humans coexist, the elite members of the organization [Demon-Slaying Warriors], which stands against the demon threat, face a family crisis!
S-rank Demon-Slaying Warriors Mizuki, Cecilia, and Rekka learn that Mizuki's daughter Akari has failed her infiltration mission and been captured. To rescue Akari, the three infiltrate the demons' lair, but they are discovered by the enemy.
Cecilia and Rekka get caught in the demons' schemes, while Mizuki ventures alone into the [Breeding Dungeon] where her daughter is held.
The harsh trials awaiting her shake Mizuki's heart and bonds... Resist and protect to the end—the epic battle to save her beloved family begins now!
Will Mizuki and the others successfully rescue Akari? Witness the touching conclusion together.

GAMEPLAY
In a world where demons and humans are in conflict, brave Demon-Slaying Warriors fight to protect family bonds in this emotional RPG!
Enjoy a wealth of scenarios tailored to various playstyles and captivating character development.
Experience immersive storytelling with Live2D animations!

FEATURES
·High-Frequency Event System: New developments unfold every time you explore the Breeding Dungeon! A stress-free, smooth progression design.
·No Leveling Required: Jump straight into the main story with a simple system.
·Battles emphasize strategy for a refreshing experience!
·Voice & Animation: Lively character expressions and voice acting deliver maximum immersion.
·Multiple Character Selection: Choose from 3 types—housewife, tough mom, or sister—for play. Unique experiences based on each attribute!
